title: Generative Recommenders Forget the Long Tail: Restoring Memorization in Retrieval and Ranking
abstract: arXiv:2610.29298v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative recommenders replace the retrieve-then-rank cascade with a single model: beam search over semantic item identifiers performs retrieval, and the same likelihood performs ranking. We show that this shared score makes them forget long-tail items twice. In retrieval, beam search keeps identifier prefixes by the probability mass of their subtrees, so tail items are pruned early, and a wider beam admits few more of them. In ranking, the likelihood places tail items below head items even when they are admitted, so expanding retrieval alone brings little or no gain. Both failures reflect missing item-level memorization (i.e., direct recall of which items co-occur), which collaborative filtering provides and shared-prefix generation lacks. To this end, we propose CAPE (Co-occurrence-Aware Pool Expansion), a training-free plug-in that restores memorization at both stages: (i) a memorization channel retrieves co-occurrence-supported tail

translated_title: 生成式推荐系统遗忘了长尾：在检索与排序中恢复记忆能力
translated_abstract: 生成式推荐系统用单一模型取代了传统的“先检索后排序”级联流程：通过对语义物品标识符进行束搜索来完成检索，并使用相同的似然函数进行排序。我们证明这种共享评分机制会导致模型在两个环节遗忘长尾物品。在检索阶段，束搜索依据标识符前缀子树的概率质量来保留候选前缀，因此长尾物品被过早剪枝，即使加宽束宽也只能召回少量长尾物品。在排序阶段，即使长尾物品被召回，似然函数也会将其排在头部物品之后，因此仅扩大检索范围几乎无法带来收益。这两种失效都源于物品级记忆能力（即直接回忆哪些物品共同出现的能力）的缺失——协同过滤具备这种能力，而共享前缀生成则缺乏。为此，我们提出CAPE（共现感知池扩展，Co-occurrence-Aware Pool Expansion），这是一种免训练的即插即用模块，能够在两个阶段恢复记忆能力：(i) 一个记忆通道用于检索由共现支持的长尾……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出免训练插件CAPE，利用物品共现记忆机制修复生成式推荐系统中长尾物品在检索与排序两个阶段被系统性遗忘的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes CAPE, a training-free plug-in that restores item-level co-occurrence memorization to rescue long-tail items systematically forgotten in both the retrieval and ranking stages of generative recommenders.
